dialogues.speaker: Kamal
dialogues.text: Hi, I'm Kamal, a Branch Master of the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Kamal
dialogues.text: I'm a former mariner. I can give you some practical tips if you want to set sail on an adventure.

dialogues.speaker: Kamal
dialogues.text: If you want to go somewhere else in Sumeru, I can show the way as well.
